competencies.statement: The learner can demonstrate active listening, including reflective statements and not interrupting.
competencies.description: Reflects/paraphrases and gives space in a session.

competencies.statement: The learner can use open-ended questions to explore a client's perspective.
competencies.description: Chooses open over closed/leading questions.

competencies.statement: The learner can build rapport and demonstrate empathy with clients.
competencies.description: Responds in ways that build trust and understanding.

competencies.statement: The learner can communicate in a non-judgmental way.
competencies.description: Avoids judgment/advice-giving language.

competencies.statement: The learner can structure a coaching session (opening, goal, exploration, action, close).
competencies.description: Moves a session through the standard arc.

competencies.statement: The learner can set a session agenda collaboratively with the client.
competencies.description: Co-creates the session focus with the client.

competencies.statement: The learner can stay within coaching scope and avoid giving medical advice.
competencies.description: Recognizes and holds the coaching/clinical boundary.

competencies.statement: The learner can help a client set SMART goals (specific, measurable, achievable, realistic, time-bound).
competencies.description: Turns a vague aim into a SMART goal.

competencies.statement: The learner can help a client identify barriers to change.
competencies.description: Surfaces obstacles that affect a goal.

competencies.statement: The learner can support a client in forming sustainable habits.
competencies.description: Applies habit-formation principles (cues, small steps).

competencies.statement: The learner can apply behavior-change models such as the Transtheoretical (Stages of Change) Model.
competencies.description: Matches an approach to a client's stage of change.

competencies.statement: The learner can apply basic knowledge of nutrition, physical activity, stress management, and sleep in a coaching context.
competencies.description: Uses general wellness knowledge appropriately.

competencies.statement: The learner can educate clients on wellness topics without prescribing or diagnosing.
competencies.description: Shares general information, not a prescription/diagnosis.

competencies.statement: The learner can describe and work within a wellness coach's scope of practice.
competencies.description: Identifies what is/ isn't within scope.

competencies.statement: The learner can maintain client confidentiality.
competencies.description: Handles client information appropriately.

competencies.statement: The learner can maintain professional boundaries with clients.
competencies.description: Sets/holds appropriate boundaries.

competencies.statement: The learner can recognize when to refer a client out for mental health or medical issues.
competencies.description: Identifies red flags that require referral.

competencies.statement: The learner can track a client's progress toward goals.
competencies.description: Uses a method to monitor progress over time.

competencies.statement: The learner can adjust a client's plan based on progress.
competencies.description: Adapts the plan when progress stalls/changes.

competencies.statement: The learner can support client accountability without pressure or judgment.
competencies.description: Encourages follow-through respectfully.

competencies.statement: The learner can engage in self-reflection on their coaching practice.
competencies.description: Reviews their own sessions to improve.

competencies.statement: The learner can receive and apply feedback constructively.
competencies.description: Uses feedback to change practice.

competencies.statement: The learner can demonstrate a growth mindset in their professional development.
competencies.description: Frames challenges as learning opportunities.

competencies.statement: The learner can develop a professional coaching identity.
competencies.description: Articulates values/approach as a coach.
